title: Nonlinear thermodynamic formalism for correspondences
summary: We develop a nonlinear thermodynamic formalism for correspondences on compact metric spaces. A continuous energy is evaluated on empirical measures of successive pairs of states. The measure-theoretic pressure of a stationary transition pair is the sum of its kernel entropy and the energy of the joint distribution of two successive states. For forward expansive correspondences satisfying an ergodic-abundance condition, we prove a variational principle and the existence of nonlinear equilibrium pairs.
